mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month average compresses the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following FEDFUNDS below the 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, triggering a repricing of equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day windows following CPIAUCSL increases exceeding 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% and an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 (index) signals robust economic conditions that reduce equity risk and generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following the joint condition of UNRATE < 4.0 and INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and sustained for 3 months), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the 60-day windows during the period when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month average indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following RSAFS above the 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day windows following UNRATE declines exceeding 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 450000.0 signals robust consumer and housing demand, boosting corporate revenue and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following the joint condition of HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 450000.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) for two consecutive months, the economy is in contraction, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following two consecutive months of INDPRO < 100.0.
